# A clause id another policy repeats

`Policy: pol-REPT` `DRAFT`

## Purpose

`pol-TWIN` has a clause of the same id, and neither clause signposts the other. A coverage report offers the two as
a pair, and nothing here says whether they are one.

## Scope

This fixture only. It exercises `shared-id-unsignposted`, which reports this side because its id sorts first.

## Clauses

| Id       | Clause                                     | Alignment |
|----------|--------------------------------------------|-----------|
| `INVENT` | **MUST** keep an inventory of what we ship |           |
